readerEvidence.summary: Original single-pass full assigned task/instruction/constants/key/artifact reading by GPT-6.1 Sol ultra, bounded literal source restoration, automated ordinary schema/math/source/figure checks, all final actual crops personally opened. No separate model checker; no organizer-rights inference.
sourceGaps: Converted DOC/DOCX/TXT and image-PDF aliases remain derivative provenance, not asserted native-PDF equivalence.
Shared exact source hashes render once; role placements do not duplicate original reading credit.
IOM solutions physical1–2 concern other tasks and are excluded; only the historical exact task3 scope physical3–4 is rendered/read.
Photographed/PNG originals remain full native resolution. Original source bytes and old manifests stay untouched.

72 is the exact unique retained source-artifact page count, not a claim that every artifact was originally a native PDF. Native DOC/DOCX/TXT conversions retain their declared provenance; original image sources were viewed at full native pixel dimensions.
Reported defects were source-reading leads only. Printed disagreement between primary and companion versions is preserved explicitly; no independently calculated scientific corrections are made.
Archive availability and event-branded source headings do not establish organizer publication rights or blanket reproduction permission.
Preparation image flags remain the immutable pre-reading record. This completed checkpoint records the actual subsequent page openings.
Bulgarian revised three long questions; all connected requests, diagrams, equation of state and first-law conventions read. The question wording and cohort remain distinct from the English question.

All thirteen pages of the revised shared marking key read, including the blank body on physical10, all three Q1 alternatives, point tables and the empty Q3(d) key row. First Cartesian orbit lines on physical4 and5 omit the square on y-star; the following lines print it. The normalized equations omit their final1. Physical5 alternative3(b) has its own word order and zenith-angle formula. Printed heat-sign and repeated-word errors are retained, not recalculated.

Ten original PNG draft-key pages opened at full native pixels. Their earlier binary probability request and extra stellar requests/mark allocations differ from the revised key; these are archive alternatives, not silently combined into competitor questions.

Both complete two-page constants editions read, including spherical trigonometry and Rayleigh-Jeans formula. Hydrogen mass is printed1.67 x10^-27 kg; a native300dpi detail resolves the small minus. Existing newline-plus-u corruption of nu must be compared to the printed glyph, not copied.

Both Bulgarian and English theoretical instructions read: answer-sheet rules, separate problem sheets, nonprogramming/nongraphic calculator, rough-paper request. No commercial or reproduction permission inferred.
